segments.name: Assessment & Qualifications
segments.description: Delivers assessments, qualifications and courseware to schools, universities, professional bodies and employers worldwide.
segments.evidence: Assessment & Qualifications – Pearson Professional Assessments, US Student Assessment, Clinical Assessment, UK GCSE and A Levels and International academic qualifications and associated courseware including the English-speaking Canadian and Australian K-12 businesses, and PDRI

segments.name: Virtual Learning
segments.description: Operates virtual schools for partner schools and provides online programme management to academic institutions.
segments.evidence: Virtual Learning – Virtual Schools and Online Program Management (up to the point of disposal in 2023)

segments.name: English Language Learning
segments.description: Sells English language tests, institutional courseware and online learning solutions to learners and institutions.
segments.evidence: English Language Learning – Pearson Test of English, Institutional Courseware and English Online Solutions

segments.name: Higher Education
segments.description: Publishes and licenses higher education courseware for students and institutions in the US, Canada and internationally.
segments.evidence: Higher Education – US, Canadian and International Higher Education Courseware businesses

segments.name: Enterprise Learning & Skills
segments.description: Provides vocational qualifications, skills credentials and enterprise training to employers, institutions and working professionals.
segments.evidence: Enterprise Learning & Skills – Vocational qualifications, GED, TalentLens, Faethm, Credly, Pearson College (up to the point of disposal in 2023) and Enterprise content and training

revenueModel.text: Schools, universities, governments and test takers pay for assessments, courseware and services, with revenue recognised over time as performance obligations are met.
revenueModel.evidence: Revenue is generated by the provision of services for which human and physical resources are a critical and material component for performance and delivery.

changes.text: In 2025 Workforce Skills became Enterprise Learning and Skills, taking in the IT Pro business from Higher Education.
changes.evidence: In January 2025, the Group announced that Workforce Skills would evolve to become Enterprise Learning and Skills, incorporating our IT Pro business which was previously within Higher Education.

changes.text: Disposal of the final local courseware publishing businesses in 2023 left the Strategic Review business unit with no reported results.
changes.evidence: However, following the disposal of the final local courseware publishing businesses in 2023 (see note 31), there are no longer any reported results for the Strategic Review business unit.

changes.text: The POLS business and Pearson College were disposed of in 2023.
changes.evidence: In 2023, they relate to the gain on the disposal of the POLS business and gains related to the release of accruals and a provision related to historical acquisitions, offset by losses on the disposal of Pearson College
